decoding: Ordinary greedy tokenizer-vocabulary generation until EOS or the fixed token cap. No forced JSON prefix, class vocabulary, retrieved fact table or answer repair.
equivalence: Before new development questions, require byte-identical output tokens on all256previous development knowledge questions compared with the learned standalone tail. This checks composition, not independent quality.
purpose: Test useful capacity added as an independently owned transformer expert while retaining the complete original model path.
questions: Reuse the exact new question forms already committed in the unexecuted conditional-readout proposal. Neither development nor final has been evaluated by that proposal. Facts are admitted training material; only wording is held out. Existing skill and conversation probes measure retention.
scope: Operated transformer capacity growth and availability experiment. An explicit domain selector is not a general learned router. Adding a retained expert does not establish an equal-budget scaling advantage, independent operators, economic security or native settlement.
selection: One fixed graph. Require at least75% new-question correctness, original entity-cluster gain bound, zero old correct skill losses, exact original skill answers and conversation losses, and the declared question-only selector. Commit all development evidence before any final. Require parent generation to continue after the added worker process has exited, as observed by the controller.
selector: Use the added expert exactly when the user question contains fictional Luma directory, case-insensitively. No entity, attribute, expected answer or evaluation ID enters routing. Otherwise execute the unchanged parent through its independent three-owner process group.
stop: Abort on composition, integrity, numerical or deadline failure. Publish a failed gate without tuning the graph or opening an ineligible final. No native activation or issuance.
training: No new training or tuning in this composition trial. The added tail is exactly the terminal existing-tail learner from the previously frozen1024update rehearsal. Retain all original parent tensors alongside the added trained tail. Preserve actual Adam state and training provenance.
retention_baseline: Reuse the recorded original-parent baseline for exactly the same retained skill and conversation inputs. Bind the derived cache across owners and compare every actual parent-path token and loss exactly. Generate fresh baseline answers for the new knowledge questions. No output, dataset or gate is changed by this cache.
